source_candidate.display_label: Harness Evolver strategy reopening / evaluation-isolation boundary
source_candidate.identity_note: The sealed source artifact does not expose an explicit source-local candidate identifier. This audit is bound to the exact namespace/path/blob and must not be fuzzy-joined downstream by title or semantic alias.

grade.matched_independent_reproduction: C / not located in this search

findings.finding: Explicit strategy reopening is genuinely wired into the documented evolve path.
findings.evidence: skills/evolve/SKILL.md auto-triggers the Opus harness-architect after three consecutive iterations within 1% or a score drop. harness-architect.md classifies topology and proposes one-iteration migrations such as single-call->RAG/tools, chain->parallel, ReAct stopping/hierarchical routing, and ensemble/verification.
findings.scope: This verifies implementation intent and routing, not that reopening improves outer-test performance.

findings.finding: Reopening competes with separately specified stopping heuristics rather than following one executable evidence-validated control law.
findings.evidence: The same evolve skill separately states: three scores within 2% => consider architect or stop; target reached => stop; average improvement <0.5% over five iterations => stop. tools/iteration_gate.py implements another three-gate formulation, but repository search plus the audited evolve skill show no invocation of iteration_gate.py in the main /harness:evolve path.
findings.scope: The control semantics are therefore partly orchestration-instruction behavior rather than one uniquely replayable gate implementation.

findings.finding: The 30% held_out partition is an adaptive candidate-selection surface, not an untouched outer lockbox.
findings.evidence: tools/setup.py creates only train and held_out splits. Every evolve iteration ranks candidates with read_results.py --split held_out, and pairwise comparison also uses held_out. No third outer_test/final_test/lockbox split was found in the audited repository. Changelog v5.1.2 fixes a different leak by preventing held_out failures from being copied into train regression guards, but repeated winner selection on held_out remains by design.
findings.scope: This does not make held_out scores invalid; it limits them to adaptively selected in-loop evidence and weakens claims of untouched final generalization.

findings.finding: Fresh setup does not deterministically reproduce the train/held_out membership from the same input corpus.
findings.evidence: assign_splits() calls random.shuffle(examples) without setting or recording a seed. .evolver.json stores dataset name/id but not a split seed or explicit example-id membership list. If only the original corpus is available and the remote LangSmith dataset snapshot is not, the probability that two independent uniform 70/30 shuffles yield the same train subset is 1/C(n,floor(0.7n)): n=20 => 1/38,760 = 2.58e-5; n=30 => 1/14,307,150 = 6.99e-8; n=50 => 1/2,250,829,575,120 = 4.44e-13.
findings.scope: An existing LangSmith dataset_id can preserve the original split for that account/object; the defect is independent/public reconstruction from inputs, not necessarily same-dataset rerun.

findings.finding: The certification step measures repeatability on the configured dataset, not post-selection generalization on a fresh outer set.
findings.evidence: skills/certify/SKILL.md runs run_eval.py three times using the same .evolver.json dataset and reports mean/std. This can detect stochastic instability or judge variance, but it does not create or consume an untouched outer dataset after adaptive evolution.
findings.scope: STABLE therefore means repeatable score on the configured evaluation surface, not independently validated generalization.

findings.finding: The public agno-deepknowledge 0.575->1.000 example remains primary project evidence, not a matched independent reproduction.
findings.evidence: Fresh web/repository search on 2026-08-27 found the result in the official README/package mirrors and listings, but no source-matched third-party rerun with the same dataset, model snapshot, split membership, proposer budget and outer evaluation.
findings.scope: Absence in this search is not proof that no private or unindexed reproduction exists.

split_membership_probability_recalculati.assumption: uniform independent shuffle and comparison of train-set membership only

independent_checks.repository_drift_check: Current public main SHA equals the worker-pinned revision, so these implementation findings are current as of the audit.

reproducibility_requirements_for_upgrade: Persist immutable dataset example IDs and split membership or a deterministic split seed plus source-corpus hash.
Separate adaptive candidate selection, strategy-reopening diagnostics and final untouched outer evaluation into auditable channels.
Wire one explicit executable strategy-control policy or persist the exact branch decision and threshold state for each iteration.
Publish a source-matched evolution run bundle with model/version, dataset snapshot, evaluator/rubric snapshot, proposer budget, candidate chronology, merge decisions and final outer-test results.
Provide a matched causal ablation of plateau-stop versus architect-reopen versus scheduled architecture search at equal compute, ideally with an independent rerun.
scope_guards: Do not infer that strategy reopening is harmful; the audit establishes adaptive-selection and replay limitations, not a negative causal effect.
Do not infer that the reported official demo is fabricated; it is primary in-loop evidence whose outer-generalization status is unresolved.
Do not join this audit downstream by display label because the sealed source artifact lacks an explicit source-local candidate id.
